overview.description: The First Trust Developed Markets ex-US AlphaDEX Fund (FDT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of international, developed-market stocks, selected by growth and value factors and equal-weighted in tiers. FDT was launched on Apr 18, 2011 and is issued by First Trust.
